regions.name: Charlotte-Mecklenburg
regions.model_scope: Charlotte-Mecklenburg independent 2024–25 North Carolina grade-school district models: exact operational CCD LEA 3702970 / native NC-600 / PSU 600 identities. All 146 audited tested-grade configurations remain visible with same-year April individual EDS. Native regular RG/GS/ALL published GLP Level 3+ rates support 145 Math, 146 ELA and 145 Combined fits. Grade 8 mathematics includes NC Math 1 EOC. Valid-score count scope and the ten-valid-scored floor remain uncertified; sampling intervals are unavailable for every model. Both primary-only schools and all high, mixed, unknown and district aggregate records remain outside this separate published-rate district release.
